status: First bounded tests; no formation model selected

crust.context_note: Published NASA PGDA summary, Goossens & Sabaka 2026. Not a new gravity inversion. Reported plus/minus values are not used as independent Gaussian uncertainties. Different regularization and density assumptions prevent mixing these densities with old thickness maps as a fitted solution.
crust.layer_note: Synthetic sensitivity grid, not mineral-specific compositions or a petrological fit. Empty pores occur only in the upper layer; the basal layer has no porosity. A 14 km endmember is motivated by a local InSight interpretation, not a global measurement. Density inversion is a necessary instability condition, not a foundering timescale.

feedback.note: Independent finite-volume solution of a steady spherical conductive-shell perturbation. Relative thermal response is the relative linear growth rate only under a common positive heating-to-temperature feedback coefficient. No geological growth timescale is assigned. Large e-fold counts illustrate extrapolation outside guaranteed linear validity.

boundary.note: Meridional median MOLA profiles in the Nilosyrtis region, not fault traces or boundary-normal sections. Gaussian signed loads are scenarios, not mapped deposits. Each assumed history has an exact backward topographic correction; topography alone cannot rank them. No viscous flow, fault slip, erosion chronology or true polar wander is reconstructed.

paleomagnetism.note: Synthetic Arai-line counterexample only. No real specimen field, age or geographic direction is re-estimated.
